purpose: Section-level locators for high-use primary claims in the 2022 national mathematics standard.
verification_note: MOE notice identifies the mathematics standard as attachment 5 and government mirrors expose the same PDF. The official PDF is about 40 MB and could not be rendered by the current fetch path, so printed pages remain null. Section hierarchy and requirement text were cross-checked against accessible transcriptions of the same standard.

locators.locator: 三、课程目标 → （三）学段目标
locators.summary: Primary is divided into Grades 1-2, 3-4 and 5-6 learning stages.

locators.locator: 四、课程内容 → （小学部分）→ （一）数与代数 → 第一学段（1-2年级）→ 内容要求 → 1.数与运算 → （1）-（2）
locators.summary: Meaning/place value of numbers within 10,000 and comparison using <, = and >.

locators.locator: 四、课程内容 → （小学部分）→ （一）数与代数 → 第一学段（1-2年级）→ 内容要求 → 1.数与运算 → （3）-（6）
locators.summary: Meanings/relationships of four operations; addition/subtraction and simple multiplication/division reasoning and algorithms in context.

locators.locator: 四、课程内容 → （小学部分）→ （一）数与代数 → 第三学段（5-6年级）→ 内容要求 → 1.数与运算 → （1）
locators.summary: Divisibility by 2, 3 and 5; common multiples/LCM; common factors/GCF; odd/even; prime/composite.

locators.locator: 四、课程内容 → （小学部分）→ （一）数与代数 → 第三学段（5-6年级）→ 内容要求 → 1.数与运算 → （2）-（4）
locators.summary: Decimal/fraction meaning and counting units; decimal-fraction conversion; integer division/fraction relationship; simple fraction and decimal operations.

locators.locator: 四、课程内容 → （小学部分）→ （一）数与代数 → 第三学段（5-6年级）→ 内容要求 → 2.数量关系 → （1）-（6）
locators.summary: Equality properties; estimation; letters for relationships/properties/patterns; ratio/proportion; directly proportional quantities.

locators.locator: 四、课程内容 → （小学部分）→ （二）图形与几何 → 第二学段（3-4年级）→ 图形的认识与测量
locators.summary: Perimeter and area developed through geometric measurement and units.

locators.locator: 四、课程内容 → （小学部分）→ （二）图形与几何 → 第三学段（5-6年级）→ 图形的认识与测量
locators.summary: Areas of parallelograms/triangles/trapezia; circles; specified solid volume/surface area; area/volume/capacity units.

locators.locator: 四、课程内容 → （小学部分）→ （二）图形与几何 → 第三学段（5-6年级）→ 图形的位置与运动
locators.summary: Ordered pairs for position and further study of translation, rotation and axial symmetry.

locators.locator: 四、课程内容 → （小学部分）→ （三）统计与概率 → 第二学段（3-4年级）→ 数据的收集、整理与表达
locators.summary: Collect/organise/analyse data; bar charts; meaning of the mean in simple contexts.

locators.locator: 四、课程内容 → （小学部分）→ （三）统计与概率 → 第三学段（5-6年级）→ 内容要求 → 1.数据的收集、整理与表达 → （1）-（5）
locators.summary: Line/pie charts, data interpretation and percentage in context with statistical meaning.

locators.locator: 四、课程内容 → （小学部分）→ （三）统计与概率 → 第三学段（5-6年级）→ 内容要求 → 2.随机现象发生的可能性
locators.summary: Simple random phenomena and qualitative descriptions of likelihood.

locators.locator: 四、课程内容 → （小学部分）→ （四）综合与实践 → 第三学段（5-6年级）→ 主题活动1：如何表达具有相反意义的量
locators.summary: Negative numbers encountered in familiar contexts as quantities with opposite meanings within theme/project learning.

locators.locator: 三、课程目标 → （一）核心素养内涵; （二）总目标
locators.summary: Mathematical ways of seeing, thinking and expressing the real world, together with knowledge, skills, ideas, activity experience and problem solving.
